items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All 5 acceptance criteria implemented and tested; spec-reviewer PASS round 2; no extra features.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: origin_numbers catches OSError/SubprocessError (reads as nothing); readers never raise on a missing map; git failures fall back to the local tree.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Read-only readers; git invoked with a list argv, no shell; no secrets; rel paths come from repo spec discovery.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Behaviour tests on real git repos incl. regression for a colliding hand-written row, two-sources-one-target, cross-file and two-hop moves, plan()-level origin/main check; a vacuous assert was removed.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One git show per spec file, 60s timeout; catalogs read once per call.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New code split into fr_split_report.py; every touched file <=300 lines (_keystone_ac_digest.py exactly 300).

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Consumers of the AC-Move-Map table (fr_split writer, readers) round-trip tested on a real git repo and a probe cut of FR-01.11 AC21-25; AcChangeSet.moved has a default, no serializer.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: To be run at F0 (scan_test_hygiene --diff) together with the full suite.
